details:
Q1. Which area should be improved?
Choices:
A. Clarify / planning workflow
B. Implement / review-autofix workflow
C. Orchestrator / validation / polling workflow
D. Documentation / README / setup
E. Other - name the exact workflow, script, or file (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What does "better" mean for that area?
Choices:
A. Fix incorrect behavior - include current behavior and expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Reduce flakes / stalls / duplicate automation - include when it happens (RECOMMENDED)
C. Improve speed / cost / alert noise - include what should improve
D. Add or change functionality - include the user-visible result you want
Q3. What concrete example should we use as the acceptance target?
Choices:
A. A specific issue / PR / workflow run / log snippet showing the problem (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific file / path / symbol that should change (RECOMMENDED)
C. No existing example - I will provide 1-2 sentences of acceptance criteria
